## [4.0.0](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/compare/v3.2.0...v4.0.0) (2026-06-25)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* Smarter way to detect reference for alignemnt and methylations marks present in the bam file. HG38 is now by default pointing toward the analysisSet for better coverage calculation without ambiguous mapping

### Features

* Added reporting of how much % of the genome is covered by a bed file used for enrichment in the final multiQC ([a329ef6](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/a329ef64c0e38d95e8a58ca1d9066492286ccaa3))
* Adding functions to extract usefull information from the end of run json file generated by Minknow ([408ab87](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/408ab87037bca12c044c49ba73d679e870223139))
* Adding pore scan and pore activity graph in the Susihi MultiQC report ([f8048f2](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/f8048f2b675890878787a68225e0b8702a489b32))
* Customised multiQC report to have more readibility on the metrics that matter the most ([ee9dae3](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/ee9dae3f71b37486dbd054b9a49207941ca9a670))
* Further integration and sucessfull test with Doradov2.0.0 ([4391ef5](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/4391ef51c31afa4b3f0942683701bb39de0b9e65))
* Remove variant calling from sushi pipeline to migrate it toward pika pipeline for further improvements [#104](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/104) ([ef0f17f](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/ef0f17f5ac01d8138e227330669124f8340f28d1))
* Removed from output bam the secondary mappings [#108](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/108) ([d1e96c8](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/d1e96c84c4422926e1277e39535593f2d270ee41))
* Smarter calculation of stats specific to adaptive sampling ([45947ae](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/45947ae3c2300a30d1fde2e62e90363a7d3c7a69))
* Smarter way to detect reference for alignemnt and methylations marks present in the bam file. HG38 is now by default pointing toward the analysisSet for better coverage calculation without ambiguous mapping ([898ffb1](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/898ffb1527016c3182bf048db5beae6bb48aa85f))
* Trimming sushi with the new HACv6 and doradov2 ! We no longer parse accuracy nor dorado version, because once we go for doradov2, it's much harder to offer retro compatibility, better to just use an older version of sushi, the models it uses will still be in place ! [#105](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/105) ([c30285c](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/c30285ceb5eb76d3896dd9385765112e40a40b84))


### Bug Fixes

* brought back the secondary mappings. Woops ! Someone else needs them. ([fbd6acd](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/fbd6acd1da21452331c4c3431f7a60d394174ae1))
* Redefined test scenarios in accordance to the default alignment switch ([77dad1c](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/77dad1c496d9155c0214e066315f014391aa92e8))
* Updated the MPLX and AS dataset with the latest sequencing summary headers ([8e1814d](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/8e1814d9fa321cd4d971f26ac9d8f7cc26cc8b19))

## [3.2.0](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/compare/v3.1.1...v3.2.0) (2026-05-12)


### Features

* Add more filtering steps with sniffles2 for SV detection, following Rotterdam's procedure ([bda8bf9](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/bda8bf9d62cbe9ca5a69a5d42d9c2a4bdef06a0c))
* Added a filering step for sniffles2 SV only when experiment is Adaptive Sampling to reduce noise in detecting meaningfull SV. The filtering step uses the bed use for adaptive sampling ([8840193](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/8840193e294f372128dd19679fd6e2f86e67fbc5))
* Adding a rule to filter SNV file for emedgene with bcftools ([ee4de21](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/ee4de219647d970aa736efaacd94baeb64b5ea7e))
* Oof ! Removing all the models from sushi repo and using the shared models location instead. Sushi becomes suddenly much lighter.  ([78bf00f](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/78bf00f76786bed362dad8b9bbb0a87d81498593))
* Updating sniffles to exactly version 2.5.3 which is the one compatible with Emedgene [#91](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/91) ([4c73a0c](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/4c73a0ce88fcd1201125b06ca5bd7ffaa00c4ba4))
* Updating the merge_request templates [#102](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/102) ([5fa6f71](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/5fa6f711d935c6e5b71d16c5e9c421d3b7619cdf))
* VCF plots were never used and it also does not exist with the latest version of sniffles2 for emedgene compatibility, so removing the step ([cb888ba](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/cb888ba8f93f9bc2e27dfc0eeda1e77ea5a8cf4d))


### Bug Fixes

* Add the words "error" and "success" depending on sushi's status after execution, which allows start sushi to parse these words in the logs and react to it accordingly [#103](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/103) ([3b429b8](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/3b429b8dc9ce7639a7268411e33b7d1664a509a7))
* Adding filtering for SV generated by sniffles2 for emedgene compatibility ([2ecb8b2](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/2ecb8b2a768a9dbc3018d44b2cbef1c9cdbe30c5))

## [3.0.0](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/compare/v2.9.1...v3.0.0) (2026-01-09)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* Going to sushiv3, which performs variation calling and uses doradov1.3.0
* Removing bam2fastq step AND Nanolyze (lambda removal) step, as there will be no more DNA cs added in futures librairies for Nanopore

### Features

* Changed the way MultiQC folder are created on the M drive to facilitate browsing specific type of data [#85](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/85) ([636dfda](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/636dfdaadb5d418816d976fbb502c048ba357162))
* Going to sushiv3, which performs variation calling and uses doradov1.3.0 ([af7676b](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/af7676b0b8ea8104e721c2b0c3098c34fc4ebfb3))
* Removing bam2fastq step AND Nanolyze (lambda removal) step, as there will be no more DNA cs added in futures librairies for Nanopore ([ad4290b](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/ad4290b8c1d9307945745afc710388a05c17d2ab))


### Bug Fixes

* Better filtering of Samplesheet to remove columns that are most likely not supported by dorado [#83](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/issues/83) ([4edb803](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/4edb803aace406ad728e9d8dbd530877e29cd7f2))

* Increasing also memory for alignment step to have enough room to do samtools stats due to out of memory errors ([3b7cb7b](https://gitlab.com/hg-aumc/bioinf/pipelines/sushi/commit/3b7cb7b6682f8e0a7613d104933566114125c82f))
